title: Improve incremental dependency refresh and presubmit routing for faster feedback
author: Priya Nair
description: This PR introduces an incremental dependency-refresh coordinator and refactors the presubmit routing layer so CI gives faster, more targeted feedback for dependency updates and small change sets. Motivation: our full repository dependency refresh runs are expensive and frequently trigger broad presubmit pipelines; this work reduces waste by 1) tracking a minimal transitive delta per dep-bump via a lightweight 'dep-diff' fingerprint, 2) routing presubmit lanes based on path-aware impact maps (only run runtime-heavy integration suites when the change touches core runtime or infra directories), and 3) adding an opt-in change set annotation for automated dep-rolls so maintainers can request full-sweep validation if desired. High level: - Add dep-refresh-coordinator service (lightweight Go binary) that consumes dep bump events, computes a small set of impacted targets (via dependency-graph queries and the dep-diff fingerprint), and writes a presubmit routing hint to the PR as a GitHub check. - Refactor presubmit-router to accept routing-hints from the coordinator and a new path-aware matcher; previous hardcoded routing matrix replaced by YAML policies under .github/presubmit-policies/. - Small UX: PR check shows an actionable summary (why certain suites were skipped, and a one-click button to 'run full validation'). - Backwards compat: if coordinator is unavailable we fall back to current matrix to avoid blocking. Includes security posture: dep-scan step is still inserted for all dep bumps regardless of routing. Checklist in PR body and inline build artifacts for maintainers. Related: ENG-4523 (reduce CI waste for dep automation), ENG-4599 (presubmit routing policy engine).

release_notes: Introduce dep-refresh-coordinator for incremental dep validation and refactor presubmit routing to be path-aware. Reduces CI cost for routine dep bumps and provides maintainers with a one-click full validation option.
notes_for_maintainers: If you see a routing-hint mismatch in a PR, run the 'Run full validation' button which triggers the legacy matrix. Coordinator logs are available in the infra cluster under namespace 'ci-helpers' and can be queried with 'kubectl logs -n ci-helpers dep-refresh-coordinator-0'. There is a feature flag 'PRESUBMIT_ROUTER_V2' set to on for main; to rollback flip to off and redeploy presubmit-router.
